ShortDescription.Value: Fix1 Not Enough Customers icons by balancing shop production and shopping demand.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛒 ## "Not Enough Customers" icons everywhere?
Got 100's of NEC icons, but adding more citizens doesn't always help!
#### Struggling shops don't get enough priority. * NEC appears when a normal shop goes over 90% unused Service (this is not the same as stock). * Vanilla's shopping formula has a broad **50%–100% unused Service bucket. A shop at 60% unused Service and one at 95% gets no extra priority. * So shoppers can keep choosing healthy stores while others could sit ignored above 90% and explode with NEC icons.
### Why this happens
* Shop workers get paid to produce Service. It's separate from the goods delivered to the shop (food, paper...). * Vanilla starts slowing production at 80% unused Service, but at critical 90% threshold, it's still producing at ~50% of normal. It does not clamp to 0 until it hits 100% Service (way too late). * Cims at work/school are not allowed to shop, so peak periods have less eligible shoppers of elderly and adult children.
**Shops end up making Service faster than shoppers can use it.** Adding more citizens doesn't always fix this, when struggling shops aren't getting enough priority.
### What this mod does
* Just install the mod and it works; no Options menu settings to enable or read or translate. * **Starts helping at ~82% full Service**, before the critical 90% threshold levels pop the notification icons. Rates were heavily tested to optimize for good, realistic rate buckets. * **Slows production harder** when shops are too full. Once healthy again (below 82% shop), it goes back to vanilla to handle things normally. * **Helps balance shopping demand** using existing households, not fake shoppers. * **Separately helps Leisure** businesses (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation). * **Best-effort help for hotels**, using existing tourists as Hotels are based on total rooms rented. No fake tourists added. * Example, I had 700 tourist and 8 hotels with 9000 rooms, the mod reduced my hotel NEC from 8 to 4 by adaptive priorities. After that I had to delete a couple or switch to static hotels.
### Some test results
* **130k city:** 165 NEC → 4 after ~30 minutes. * **90k city (Sunny Isle):** 335 NEC → 30 after 10 minutes, 9 after 20 minutes.
### What to expect
* **Give heavily affected cities 15–20 minutes** to rebalance; many changes happen within 5 minutes. * If you still have 10–20 left after ~30 minutes, try pruning a few excess shops. They don't have to be the exact ones showing NEC. * It won't fix every case of legit excess commercial zoning or poor access to shops. * Safe to remove. Vanilla balancing takes over again. No Harmony patch or invasive system replacement methods used.
### Support and Feedback
* Best way to support is to click the **LIKE 👍** button (top right)! No donations needed, just a free like. * Feedback is welcome on Discord or GitHub where the source code is (see icon links on the right).
